{{Quote|The Siege of Trasemene! The Assault on Vardoss IV! The Battle of Galboron! Names that will forever live in the annals of Imperial military history&hellip; and now you can see if you have the brilliance to match those who fought there!|Advertisement for the [[CS-Mark 10]] in the [[Galladinium's 50th anniversary edition|fiftieth-anniversary edition]] of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]''|<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>}}
'''Galboron''' was a celestial body<ref name="EGTW" /> situated in the [[Galboron system/Legends|Galboron system]], a part of the [[Hertae sector/Legends|Hertae sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It and the [[Nexus Ortai system/Legends|Nexus Ortai system]] were both located near the intersection of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] known as<ref name="Routes" /> the [[Askar Trace]]<ref name="SoT">''[[Stay on Target]]''</ref>&mdash;which linked them to the [[Leritor system/Legends|Leritor]], [[Lanos system/Legends|Lanos]], and [[Bresnia system/Legends|Bresnia system]]&mdash;and the [[Reena Trade Route]], which connected them to the [[Masterra system/Legends|Masterra]] and [[Spirador system/Legends|Spirador systems]].<ref name="Routes" />

In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Noolian Crisis]] began when [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] members of the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|holdouts]] of the recently defeated [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] seized Galboron and other nearby [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. The conflict was resolved when the Aqualish were [[Reconquest of the Rim|defeated]] by a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] at<ref name="EGTW" /> the famous<ref name="Galladinium" /> [[Battle of Galboron]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Galboron was first introduced as part of the name of the Battle of Galboron in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" /> In [[2012]], the reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], established Galboron as a distinct astronomical object.<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Galboron [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square Q-14.<ref name="TEA" />
